title: Unisex Sloth – Replies in 3–5 Business Days Hoodie

seo.title: Sloth Hoodie – Replies in 3–5 Business Days
seo.description: A funny sloth hoodie for slow texters: REPLIES IN 3–5 BUSINESS DAYS. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

REPLIES IN 3–5 BUSINESS DAYS. is the sloth hoodie for the friend who answers the group chat on Thursday, worn on the couch, in the group chat and to every plan confirmed at the last minute.

REPLIES IN 3–5 runs across the top and BUSINESS DAYS. fills the bottom, even wider, in heavy rounded capitals. Between them a three-toed sloth hangs upside down from a mossy branch by its claws, squinting at a smartphone in one claw with a calm half-smile, a tiny snail passing it on the branch and a few autumn leaves drifting down.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the sloth; Sand gets dark brown and deep moss-green lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a lazy day at home?
Yes. The Replies in 3–5 Business Days hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for the couch, the group chat and chilly mornings that do not require a reply.

How does the Replies in 3–5 Business Days hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for a slow texter?
It is a natural one. Every friend group has someone who answers on Thursday, so the joke lands with the slow texter, the friends who wait and anyone whose inbox is a mess. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the sloth sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Replies in 3–5 Business Days hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
